purpose: Organic Pinterest outbound click pilot for existing Payhip printable kits
creative_rules: no book covers or sales text within Pin images
discreet Emma Bellori Books signature permitted
different visual composition for every kit

measurement.test_window: after publishing, compare 14-day performance per pin
measurement.note: Links target kit anchors on the existing website, not the generic Payhip store. Images and Pinterest publication still required.

pins.title: When Your Child Is Afraid to Make Mistakes: Try This Play Activity
pins.description: A small playful step can make trying again feel less intimidating. Discover a screen-free printable activity kit with games and encouraging prompts for ages 4–8. Explore what’s included on the product page.
pins.alt: Hand-drawn child and adult at a craft table trying a new approach after an imperfect first attempt.
pins.brief: Original warm watercolor-and-colored-pencil editorial scene: handmade cardboard path game, scattered pencil crayons, child reconsidering an imperfect attempt and calm adult beside them; unpolished natural gestures, thoughtful expressions, no text or book cover.

pins.title: A Gentle Game to Help Kids Handle Losing
pins.description: After a tough game, children may need space before they can try again. Explore movement, family bingo and playful activities in a printable kit designed around big feelings and game-time frustration.
pins.alt: Hand-drawn family table with simple game pieces, a child taking a quiet pause and an adult offering calm company.
pins.brief: Original pencil and watercolor scene, board game afternoon, child upset but respected rather than caricatured, adult at child's level, handmade paper game pieces, warm muted forest and ochre palette; no lettering and no book cover.

pins.title: Friendship Activities for Kids Who Feel Left Out
pins.description: Cooperative play, puppet friends and gentle conversation starters can open space for talking about friendship and joining in. Take a look at the Room for You! printable activity kit for families.
pins.alt: Hand-drawn two children and simple paper puppets taking turns creating a pretend game on a cozy rug.
pins.brief: Original editorial illustration with children making simple paper puppets and practicing turn-taking; sincere natural expressions, warm home setting, colored pencil grain and watercolor washes, no text and no sales visuals.

pins.title: Gentle Bedtime Connection Activities for Kids
pins.description: Make evenings a little more predictable with small games, feelings cards and simple routine ideas. Explore the Together at Bedtime printable kit for parents who want calm, screen-free connection.
pins.alt: Hand-drawn parent and child preparing a cozy bedtime routine with small illustrated cards and a bedside lamp.
pins.brief: Original watercolor/pencil scene of cozy bedroom at twilight, parent and child arranging a few blank illustrated routine cards on bedside table, soft lamplight, reassuring atmosphere, no words and no book cover.

pins.title: Cute Animal Coloring and Play Activities for a Screen-Free Afternoon
pins.description: For a relaxed creative afternoon, explore animal coloring, matching pairs, a spot-the-difference game and little paper puppets. See the Cute Animal Friends printable kit and its activities.
pins.alt: Hand-drawn tabletop with cute animal drawings, colored pencils, matching cards and tiny paper puppet shapes.
pins.brief: Original professional hand-drawn editorial flat-lay, paper animal sketches, colored pencils, matching cards and paper puppets casually scattered across a textured table, visibly handmade and imperfect, no legible text and no book cover.

pins.title: Backyard Bug Detective Activities for Curious Kids
pins.description: Turn a backyard walk into a small discovery mission. Explore nature clues, matching details, cooperative games and a butterfly flipbook in the Little Bug Detectives printable kit.
pins.alt: Hand-drawn child observing a small beetle with a magnifying glass beside leaves and a field notebook.
pins.brief: Original nature-journal watercolor and colored pencil scene, child carefully observing a beetle with magnifying glass, leaves, field notes with simple non-text sketches, realistic small invertebrate proportions, no logos or book cover.
